en: The postcard is divided into two main sections: the left side shows an illustrated stag standing in a forest, possibly symbolizing hunting or nature. The right side displays a black-and-white photograph of a large building with a sign reading 'Restaurant Jägerhorn,' with several people standing outside and on a balcony. There is both printed and handwritten text on the front.
